title: Chapter 354 The Door To The New World
content:
Chapter 354 The Door To The New World

Lu Daosheng looked thoughtful. How strong would the real god be?

At this time, Lu Daosheng seemed to have thought of something, and then stopped.

Behind him, Jiang Xiaoxiao looked puzzled, but due to the depressed environment around her, she did not choose to ask, but just stood silently behind Lu Daosheng.

What she had to do next was to not disturb Lu Daosheng.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at the chaotic scene in front of him and slowly placed his hand in front of him and looked at it.

With Lu Daosheng's eyesight, he soon discovered that a breath was heading into his body in an undetectable state, as if he was about to swallow it.

Lu Daosheng knew that this should be the reason why the old man in white became like that.

Perhaps, if you can understand this aura, you can find some truth.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng stopped hesitating and sat cross-legged directly.

Those in the distance, whether it is the hanging mountains, dilapidated palaces, or hideous ancient trees, are just decorations.

It is tangible but not spiritual, and it is meaningless to Lu Daosheng and it is not enough to waste time.

The only thing that is truly useful to Lu Daosheng in the whole God is these ubiquitous mysterious auras.

On the side, looking at Lu Daosheng who suddenly sat down, Jiang Xiaoxiao hesitated for a moment, and then hurriedly sat down.

At the same time, a large amount of dark red qi suddenly began to appear throughout the God of Heaven, which gradually began to change from floating irregularly to gathering towards a certain place.

Seeing this scene, Jiang Xiaoxiao was shocked.

Because the direction where these qi gather is Lu Daosheng beside him.

In less than a moment, a small dark red vortex formed around Lu Daosheng.

Countless black gas began to gather in Lu Daosheng's body.

That's it, I don't know how long it took.

God suddenly began to become unstable, and he looked like he was shaking.

Jiang Xiaoxiao was frightened and had to keep praying that Lu Daosheng would succeed immediately.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's body also underwent significant changes as he inhaled a lot of black gas.

The most eye-catching thing is the long light red hair.

Click—

Suddenly, the space in the far distance suddenly began to crack.

Immediately afterwards, the surrounding area began to break.

God is about to collapse.

Why is this?

Jiang Xiaoxiao was very puzzled, but she had to get up and said anxiously: "Brother Sheng, Brother Sheng, this place is going to be destroyed, let's go!"

However, Lu Daosheng was unmoved.

As time passed, the space crack finally spread to the two of them.

Jiang Xiaoxiao's face looked scared and her whole body trembled. This was the first time she faced death so close.

But she didn't take a step back because Lu Daosheng was next to her.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly opened his eyes.

A divine light flashed through Lu Daosheng's eyes.

"Brother Sheng, you're awake!"

Seeing Lu Daosheng open his eyes, Jiang Xiaoxiao was ecstatic.

Lu Daosheng looked at the broken space in front of him and stretched out his right hand lightly.

Buzz —

The next moment, the space trembled.

A crystal clear jade hangs in front of Lu Daosheng.

The Sky Stone!

That was something that Lu Daosheng accidentally obtained from the Xiao clan's ancestral land in the fairy world back then.

The system told him this name.

What's even more amazing is that this thing is not even in the system store, which has allowed Lu Daosheng to treasure it until now.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng finally understood the purpose of this thing.

With the appearance of the Sky Stone, the space that was constantly shattering in front of Lu Daosheng and his two men suddenly stopped shattering miraculously.

The next moment, the broken space began to gradually return to its original shape, as if nothing had happened.

But Lu Daosheng and the others knew clearly that the scene just now was definitely not an illusion.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's palm moved slightly.

The sky-repairing stone quickly came to Lu Daosheng's hands.

At the same time, Lu Daosheng closed his eyes again, and the endless black aura absorbed in his body immediately gathered into Lu Daosheng's palm.

Under Jiang Xiaoxiao's shocked gaze, the Sky-Supplementing Stone gradually changed from its original jade white crystal clear appearance to a dark black strange stone.

This strange stone was filled with an extremely strange aura.

Feeling the faint and extremely uncomfortable aura from the Bu Tian Stone, Jiang Xiaoxiao couldn't help but take two steps back.

At this time, Lu Daosheng opened his eyes, and the black air in his body had now flowed into the Bu Tian Stone, so her appearance had also returned to her original face.

Lu Daosheng looked at the Sky-Booning Stone in his hand. Looking at the blood-red Sky-Booning Stone at this moment, Lu Daosheng finally showed a faint smile.

"So the key is always in my hands."

Lu Daosheng murmured to himself, then threw it hard.

The Sky-Busting Stone in his hand flew straight into the void.

Boom!

In an instant, the world changed.

A ferocious gap was suddenly cracked in the dim sky, and there was a hazy inside, and a strange murmuring came from a faint feeling, making people feel numb from the scalp.

Looking at the gap in the sky, Lu Daosheng's smile became brighter and brighter.

He had been waiting for a long time on this day.

New World!

"Brother Sheng, I, I feel a little uncomfortable."

At this time, a weak voice suddenly came from Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng turned his head and saw Jiang Xiaoxiao's face pale and her whole body could not stop trembling.

He realized that Jiang Xiaoxiao's realm was too low and he could no longer bear the breath here.

Now that the door to the new world has been opened, Jiang Xiaoxiao has obviously reached her limit.

If it weren't for protecting her secretly, Jiang Xiaoxiao would have died at this moment.

Lu Daosheng slowly opened his palm.

The world in the palm suddenly emerged.

"You can stay in there for a while first, and I will send you out after I've processed it."

After saying that, Lu Daosheng didn't wait for Jiang Xiaoxiao to react, so he forced Jiang Xiaoxiao into the world in his palm.

In this way, we returned to the state of one person again.

He must be extremely terrifying at this moment.

Buzz —

As the space around him slowly fluctuated, Lu Daosheng's figure began to gradually rise and slowly headed towards the gap in the void.

Just as Lu Daosheng was about to get close, Lu Daosheng suddenly thought of something and stopped.

Looking back, Lu Daosheng's eyes passed through the barrier and saw the Blue Star at this moment.

At this moment, because of the sudden disappearance of the old man in white, everyone in God had already started to panic.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

He had no worries about Blue Star anymore, and he thought he could let go completely.

But before he left, he still couldn't help it.

Blue Star is his hometown.
